confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Berlin price levels, not from inspected listings or menus. Restaurant and drink anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which is uncertain because July is peak season and hotel rates vary widely. The FX value comes from a search snippet of the RBA homepage (4pm, 14 Oct 2026); I did not verify it against the F11.1 table, and a Trading Economics market quote of 0.6971 on the same day is a rough cross-check.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Berlin's position among large German and northern European city-break destinations, roughly in line with Hamburg and Cologne for restaurants and accommodation, below Munich. Cocktail and wine anchors are inferred from the beer and restaurant price level because direct knowledge of bar pricing is weaker.
